description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named GameController that handles HTTP endpoints related to game scores. It provides functionality for submitting new scores, retrieving the leaderboard, and handling validation errors. The controller interacts with a ScoreRepository for data persistence and includes detailed Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: GameController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for score submission and leaderboard retrieval, with integrated validation, data persistence, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: createScore
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a new score. Validates input, persists the Score entity, and calculates the rank based on scores greater than the submitted score.

methods.name: getLeaderboard
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the top scores ordered by score descending and createdAt ascending, with optional limit parameter.

methods.name: handleValidationException
methods.description: Handles validation errors for request payloads, returning detailed field error messages.
